insight: Debuted as 'Project Tailwind' at Google I/O 2023, co-created by bestselling science author Steven Johnson.
name: NotebookLM
tagline: Grounded research notebook — chat your sources, get Audio Overviews.
description: Google's source-grounded research tool — upload docs, PDFs, and links, then ask questions answered only from your material, with citations and shareable Audio Overviews. Powered by Gemini.

modelSupport.notes: Grounded in your uploaded sources, powered by Gemini.

edge: Answers strictly from your uploaded sources — no open-web drift — and turns a doc set into a two-host podcast.
pros: Mind maps, slides, quizzes from sources

references.title: NotebookLM now lets you listen to a conversation about your sources
